about: What the theater's player pages may not load. Read by streaming/guest.js on desktop and copied into the Android app for Theater.kt. Patterns are matched against the full request URL, case-sensitively.
notes: Ad tags move to fresh or hijacked domains every few days, so the patterns catch their URL shapes instead:
/<zone>/<32 hex> and a bare /<zone> are push and pop-under loaders (seen on 2Embed: the fake cash-prize overlay).
A two-letter subdomain with two random mixed-case path parts is the fake 'confirm you are over 18' overlay (seen on VidZee).
